review_findings: Factory is module-lived and limited to _HintResizeHandle; unrelated QFrame behavior remains unchanged.
Qt retains/cache-owns QAccessibleWidget. Widget retains the Python adapter, which retains its separate QAccessibleValueInterface; no manual cache registration or deletion is added.

interface_cast returns shiboken6.VoidPtr to the retained value interface and delegates all other types. The failed bare-integer implementation and exit139 are preserved; no claim that an integer is safe.
Current value and bounds come from existing HintBar geometry methods. Whole-pixel setters reject boolean/non-numeric/nonfinite/fractional/out-of-range values before resize, then honor disabled state.
Standard Increase/Decrease reuse the existing font-line step and height clamp. No-op/boundary/disabled actions do not emit persistence changes; inherited focus action and Up/Down key bindings remain.
Resize-event notices report actual changed help-strip height, including existing mouse/manual paths. No-op height changes do not notify.
All HintBar methods, existing mouse behavior, public docstrings/captions and translation artifacts remain untouched. Existing private keyboard resize body delegates to the same commit path.

Tests exercise real accessible interface/value/action retrieval, GC retention and Qt cache retirement after owner deletion, alongside existing keyboard/mouse cases. Relayout test waits for the actual queued layout before reading new bounds.
evidence_interpretation: Final33PASS and corrected3PASS are exact owner-run logs, not independently repeated runs.
The initial3failure baseline, exit139 pointer failure and later32PASS/1FAIL test-timing failure remain intact and explicitly classified.
limits: No tests/generator/collector/runtime model execution repeated by independent reviewer.
Acceptance is bounded local Qt6.12 offscreen software evidence. Native AT-SPI Value transport, Orca speech, older supported PySide versions and Windows/macOS remain unproven.
No whole numbered N655 completion claim or progress-table tick.
